title: Affine subspace regularity by codimension
statement: Let $n,k\ge 0$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Suppose the subspace orthogonal to $H$ under the standard dot product over $\mathbb F_2$ has dimension $k$. Then the indicator of $a+H$, transported to $\{\pm1\}^n$ by the coordinatewise binary-to-sign correspondence, has every nonempty-set Fourier coefficient bounded in absolute value by $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
The orthogonal complement of $H$ has dimension $k$
